description: This PHP source file defines an ExceptionSubscriber class that implements Symfonys EventSubscriberInterface. The class subscribes to kernel exception events and customizes HTTP responses based on the exception type, primarily used within the OrangeHRM installer component.

classes.name: ExceptionSubscriber
classes.description: A subscriber class that handles exception events during the Symfony kernel execution, customizing the HTTP response based on the exception details.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the array of events this subscriber is listening to, specifically the kernel exception event with a priority of 500.

methods.name: onExceptionEvent
methods.description: Handles the exception event, setting an appropriate HTTP response status and headers based on the exception type.
